animations.name: Medium Punch Low
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start from the exact supplied low kneeling crouch guard pose. Animate ONE SINGLE heavy crouching cross punch spread continuously across the clip (never a second punch or preliminary jab), pure body motion only in empty air: staying anchored in the low kneeling crouch on the baseline without standing up, Oscar performs one deliberate wind-up coil leaning his torso and right shoulder visibly back; then he twists forward and drives ONE heavy straight horizontal right cross punch to the right (right arm extending progressively to full reach, fist closed, left arm tucked behind his hip); after a brief steady apex, he smoothly retracts once back into the starting crouch guard pose. Preserve Oscar's exact face, black outfit, sneakers, scale and pixel art. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, clean sprite only.
